summary.text: Old Eccentric Tian Nan is a Remote Antiquity Era refinement path supreme grandmaster whose true inheritance at Ascending Heaven Plain later passes through Song clan into Fang Yuan's hands.

claims.text: Song Qi Yuan names his inheritance on Ascending Heaven Plain as the prize Song clan will contest against Cai clan and Ruo Lai clan. Narration calls him a refinement path supreme grandmaster of the Remote Antiquity Era, on par with Old Immortal Kong Jue and Long Hair Ancestor, and records that he had a strange personality, attempted to refine the immemorial nine heavens, and died after failing.
Human history names three most outstanding peak refinement path experts: Old Eccentric Tian Nan, Old Immortal Kong Jue, and Long Hair Ancestor.

Further recounting places him in the Remote Antiquity Era among those three supreme grandmasters, notes he was human, and says Heavenly Court collected most of his and Old Immortal Kong Jue’s true inheritances.

Song Xia Qi reports that Song clan won his true inheritance with Ascending Heaven Plain after competing with Ruo Lai clan and Cai clan. He is named a genius of the Remote Antiquity Era with high seniority, the first refinement path supreme grandmaster recorded in history, still valuable after three million years.

When Fang Yuan obtains the contents, the inheritance describes a maniacal aim to refine the immemorial two heavens and even the five regions into an external immortal aperture. He wanted to refine all the world’s dao marks, could not refine heaven path dao marks, tried an extremely risky method, and died refining the heavens. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable later obtained the same inheritance at Ascending Heaven Plain, left it intact, and in old age added refinement path notes there.
